**sdd/issue-231-a2/apply-progress**

**What**: MERGED progress, now COMPLETE. Phase 1 (660b950), Phase 2 (dc78d27), Phase 2 ADDENDUM (46fdea1), AND Phases 3+4+5 (f332c41, this session) for issue #231 A2 are all done. All tasks.md items are `[x]` except 5.3 (memory:share) and 5.4 (CP-A2a PR-body declaration), which are explicitly deferred to the orchestrator per this run's instructions (it assembles the CP-A2a push/PR).

**Why**: Final code batch of A2 — ship the GitLab governance pipeline fragment (Decision 1), extend the drift-guard to cover it (Decision 5), and close the GitHub-side approved-label hardcode (Decision 4) so no runtime code anywhere hardcodes `status:approved` after this slice.

**Where** (commit f332c41, 7 files, 287 insertions/14 deletions):
- `brain/core/managed-paths.mjs` — added the LITERAL `brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml` to `managed[]` (TOUCHES brain/core → L6 brain-writes-reviewed gate engages, 5th slice to touch a brain/core file this program, expected PASS+warn, same established path). No root `.gitlab-ci.yml` entry (Decision 1 — consumer root stays LOCAL).
- `brain/scripts/lib/managed-paths.test.mjs` — 2 new RED→GREEN tests: the literal is present; no `.gitlab-ci.yml` entry exists.
- `brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml` (NEW) — 8-job GitLab pipeline fragment. Header comment documents: `include: local:` one-line opt-in; `VCS_TOKEN`/`HTTP(S)_PROXY` sourced via GitLab CI/CD project variables (never hardcoded, no per-job `variables:` mapping needed — GitLab auto-injects project-level CI/CD vars); `CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH` is a free standard predefined var, auto-available to every job (no explicit mapping needed, unlike GitHub Actions). All 8 jobs run `node <entrypoint>` — issue-link/diff-size/memory-gate/decision-gate via `run-check.mjs <job>`, phase-order via `phase-order-check.mjs`, actor-check via `actor-check.mjs`, brain-writes-reviewed via `brain-writes-reviewed.mjs`, local-checks via `npm run repo:check && npm run brain:nav && npm test`. Scoped via a hidden `.governance_mr_rules` template (`extends:`) to `$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"` only — mirrors GitHub's `on: pull_request` trigger scoping (own design decision, not explicitly mandated by spec/design but consistent with it — MR-only context fields would otherwise fail-closed for the wrong reason on branch-push pipelines).
- `brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs` — extended with 3 new assertion groups (10 new tests total): (1) job-name set == `GOVERNANCE_JOBS` via a new `extractGitlabJobNames()` (zero-indent top-level YAML keys, excludes hidden `.`-prefixed template keys); (2) per-job `allow_failure: true` present IFF job ∈ `DETECTION_JOBS`, via `extractGitlabJobBlock()` (loop over all 8 `GOVERNANCE_JOBS`); (3) a GitLab-side wiring guard — the fragment must NEVER locally assign `CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH:` (that would shadow the platform-provided predefined var and reintroduce a hardcoded default-branch literal, the exact gap the Phase 2 addendum closed). All 3 assertion groups were mutation-tested (flip `allow_failure` off on a DETECTION job → catches it; add a local `CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH:` override → catches it) to confirm real teeth, not just presence-checking.
- `brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.test.mjs` — 1 new RED→GREEN test: `governance.yml`'s `issue-link` job block must contain `$(node brain/scripts/governance/approved-label.mjs github)` and must NOT contain the literal `'status:approved'`.
- `.github/workflows/governance.yml` — `issue-link` job: replaced `grep -qx 'status:approved'` with `APPROVED_LABEL=$(node brain/scripts/governance/approved-label.mjs github)` then `grep -qx "$APPROVED_LABEL"`. `diff-size` stays bash/unchanged (only the label read moved, per REQ-A2-3/task 5.1 scope).
- `openspec/changes/issue-231-a2/tasks.md` — Phases 3, 4, 5.1, 5.2 marked `[x]`; 5.3/5.4 left unchecked with an explicit DEFERRED note (orchestrator-owned).

**Learned**:
- STRICT TDD SEQUENCING GOTCHA for YAML-fragment-plus-drift-guard work: creating the YAML fragment (3.3) BEFORE writing its drift-guard assertions (4.1/4.2) risks a false-negative RED — if the YAML is already correct when the test is added, the test never actually fails. Fixed by temporarily `mv`-ing the just-created `gitlab-governance.yml` out of the repo before adding the 10 new drift-guard tests, confirming genuine RED (10 failures, all `ENOENT`), then restoring the file for GREEN (23/23 pass). This is the reusable pattern for "ship an artifact + guard it in a later phase": stage the artifact temporarily out of the way to prove the guard's RED is real, not a byproduct of good implementation luck.
- A RED sourced purely from `ENOENT` (file-absent) does not prove the assertion LOGIC (job-set equality, allow_failure-iff-DETECTION, no-override) is actually correct — it only proves the test engages when the target is missing. Did 2 additional mutation-test passes after GREEN to close this gap: (1) removed `allow_failure: true` from `actor-check` (a DETECTION job) → test correctly went red, then reverted; (2) added a local `variables: { CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH: 'main' }` override to `issue-link` → the no-override guard correctly went red, then reverted. Both confirmed real detection power, not vacuous truth.
- Comment-text self-sabotage: my first draft of the `.github/workflows/governance.yml` explanatory comment for the approved-label change contained the literal substring `'status:approved'` (inside a "never a hardcoded 'status:approved' literal" phrase) — this tripped my OWN new `assert.doesNotMatch(block, /'status:approved'/)` test, because the block-slice includes step-level comments, not just executable bash. Fixed by rephrasing the comment to describe the change without repeating the literal string. Reusable gotcha: a source/YAML drift-guard regex scanning for a literal will also catch that literal inside an explanatory comment about NOT using it — write such comments carefully, or scope the regex to the executable line only.
- Test count: 1108 (Phase 2 addendum baseline) → 1121 (this batch), +13 exactly: 2 (managed-paths.test.mjs) + 10 (ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs GitLab extension) + 1 (governance-checks.test.mjs issue-link source-scan) = 13. Confirmed via full `npm test`, 0 failures, before commit.
- `brain/core/` touch count for this program: managed-paths.mjs is now the 2nd brain/core file touched by A2 (after config-migrations.mjs in Phase 1); across the whole repo this is the established L6 PASS+warn path, not a novel ceremony.
- GitLab job-name extraction needed a DIFFERENT regex than the existing GitHub extractor: GitHub job names live in a `name:` field nested 4 spaces inside the job block; GitLab job identity IS the zero-indent top-level YAML key itself, so `extractGitlabJobNames()`/`extractGitlabJobBlock()` are genuinely new functions (zero-indent key matching, explicit exclusion of `.`-prefixed hidden template keys like `.governance_mr_rules`), not a reuse of the GitHub-side `extractJobBlock()`.
- No `setup-node` step needed in the modified `issue-link` bash step — confirmed by precedent: every other `node brain/scripts/...` invocation in this same `governance.yml` (memory-gate, decision-gate, phase-order, actor-check, brain-writes-reviewed) already runs `node` directly on `ubuntu-latest` with no explicit Node setup step, since GitHub-hosted runners ship Node preinstalled.

Commit: f332c41 "feat(governance): GitLab governance pipeline fragment + drift-guard parity + GitHub label read (A2 phases 3-5) (#231)" on branch feat/issue-231-a2, ONE commit, no push, no PR (per instructions — CP-A2a assembly is the orchestrator's). Full `npm test`: 1121/1121 pass, 0 failures. `repo:check` and `brain:nav` both clean. A2's tasks.md is now fully implemented except the orchestrator-owned 5.3 (memory:share) and 5.4 (CP-A2a PR-body declaration).
